SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.status, a.view_count, a.create_time FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.author_id
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT id, title, summary, content, cover, category_id, author_id, status, view_count, create_time, update_time FROM article WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, a.status, a.view_count, a.create_time, a.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment cm WHERE cm.article_id = a.id) AS comment_count FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.author_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, summary, content, cover, category_id, author_id, status, view_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{cover}, #{categoryId}, #{authorId}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, cover = #{cover}, category_id = #{categoryId}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
